title: Why is there no equation for the perimeter of an ellipse‽
summary: Stand-up Maths explains why the perimeter of an ellipse has no simple closed-form equation, showing the infinite series and presenting approximation formulas.
why: Cited as an accessible explanation of why some simple shapes lack neat exact formulas.

quote.text: the info on calculating the actual value starts at 14 minutes (it's an infinite series).
